## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. For reference corrections, link to a public source.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run readme` (when reference metadata or the README renderer changed)
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Desktop, mobile, and keyboard checks (when the interface changed)
- [ ] Only public reference metadata and website infrastructure are included; no unpublished survey content, manuscript files, or attachments are added.
